notes: kb/Work/PB445.md LANDED. "The OCCURS clause associated with identifier-1 shall contain the KEY phrase" (cite.py --check 14.9.37.3 -> OK, Syntax rules 7). SEARCH ALL over a table whose OCCURS clause declares no ASCENDING/DESCENDING KEY is now COBOL1964 at every edition, reported ALONE because SR8-SR12 are all written about that phrase and continuing would report each WHEN operand as 'not a key' for a table that declares none. The KEY phrase itself is OccursSpec.Keys -- ONE ordered list built by DataBinder.OdoBindOccursSpec and resolved by OdoModel.KeyItems; it replaced two per-direction lists the data binder WROTE and nothing READ. Negative golden rejects at 85, 2002, 2014 and 2023 with exactly one code; the positive golden proves the legal shapes still compile and answer.
